item.title: Pamela Brown (1962 – 2025)
item.description: (Worked At Ferro Corporation In Stryker) Pamela Jane Brown, age 63, of Bryan, passed away peacefully on Wednesday, December 3, 2025, at her home surrounded by her family. item.title: Mary Paine (1944 – 2025)
item.description: (Lifelong Bryan Resident) Mary Susan Paine, age 81, of Bryan, passed away on Tuesday, December 2, 2025, at Hillside Country Living, Bryan, Ohio, where she had been a resident.
